rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person who hates spending money.

example.english: He's so rich but won't even buy anyone a drink—he's a real scrooge.
example.traditional: 佢咁有錢都唔肯請人飲杯嘢，真係孤寒鬼。
